title: Preserve uncertainty when a persisted session row cannot be decoded at boot
outcome: A row-level session read failure cannot silently certify an unknown session as removed or permit destructive persistence of its retained data.
acceptance: A disposable corrupted-row witness establishes whether unknown-ID row failures bypass quarantine and how absence-dependent recovery and full-snapshot persistence treat the retained row.
Any confirmed defect is corrected while preserving valid-session hydration and existing quarantine behavior; independent review assesses the change.
